title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) Payer Agreement Rate for Pre-Operative Urinalysis
content:
The urinalysis code 81001 under revenue code 0300 on an outpatient surgery Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), when the claim's post-payment denial is refunded on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is valued at its counted units times the urinalysis fee per counted unit, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

| Payer class | Urinalysis fee per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 4.10 USD |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 3.60 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

Input, judgement, output (hypothetical):
- 2 units, Commercial PPO Claim, charges 25.00 → fee 4.10 → value 8.20.
- 3 units, Commercial HMO Claim, charges 30.00 → 3 times 3.60 → value 10.80.
- charges 25.00 with no units, Commercial HMO Claim → one counted unit → value 3.60.
